ItemId.description: The policy's 26-character id; omit it to match by name or create one.

Name.description: The technical name modules and workflows ask for, such as PayRunApproval.

Type.description: The approval type the policy serves, such as PayRun or Ticket; it decides the conditions and fields the policy has.

Types.description: The approval types of a general policy, as policies were saved before they had one type; one type is read as Type, none serves every type.

Enabled.description: Whether the policy is chosen for requests that name none. On by default.

Order.description: Where the policy comes among those that match; lower first.

MinimumAmount.description: The least amount a request must have for the policy to be chosen.

MaximumAmount.description: The most amount a request may have for the policy to be chosen.

Currency.description: The currency a request's amount must be in for the policy to be chosen.

AccessScope.description: The access scope a request must have for the policy to be chosen, such as an employer's id.

Title.description: What people see, such as Manager or Finance.

Kind.description: The approver rule provider: Permission, Role, Users, Manager or Staff (with Staff on), or one a module adds. The numbers older recipes hold are read too: 0 Permission, 1 Role, 2 Manager, 3 Staff.

Value.description: The permission's name, the role's name, or user or staff member ids separated by commas. Empty for Manager.

Approvers.description: Who may decide the stage: a person any rule names may.

RequiredApprovals.description: How many different approvers must approve the stage.

Stages.description: The stages, decided one after the other. Omit them for one stage made of Approvers and RequiredApprovals.

Kind.description: The approver rule provider: Permission, Role, Users, Manager or Staff (with Staff on), or one a module adds. The numbers older recipes hold are read too: 0 Permission, 1 Role, 2 Manager, 3 Staff.

Value.description: The permission's name, the role's name, or user or staff member ids separated by commas. Empty for Manager.

Approvers.description: Who may decide a policy without Stages: a person any rule names may.

RequiredApprovals.description: How many different approvers must approve a policy without Stages.

AllowRequesterToApprove.description: Whether the person who asked may approve their own request. Off by default.

AllowSubjectToDecide.description: Whether a person may decide a request about themselves. Off by default.

AllowSamePersonAcrossStages.description: Whether one person may decide more than one stage of a request, such as in a small team. Off by default.

DueAfterHours.description: Hours after which a request is due, for reminders.

Policies.description: The approval policies to create, or update by id or name.
